description: Weekly return series for one US stock or ETF (W-FRI, most recent last, all series end on the same Friday so tails align across symbols), for custom correlation or risk math. Covers ~4,700 US-listed stocks and ETFs only (no crypto, no foreign listings, no inverse/leveraged short funds, no intraday data); figures use weekly closes and refresh once per trading day. Unknown tickers return an error: resolve them with resolve_symbol first.

weeks.description: Only return the most recent N weeks (default: all, up to 156)

name: weekly_returns
title: Weekly return series
